Class WitnessTreeState<N,L,E,AP>

java.lang.Object
net.automatalib.modelchecker.m3c.solver.WitnessTreeState<N,L,E,AP>
Type Parameters:
N - node type of the referenced ProceduralModalProcessGraph
L - label type
E - edge type of the referenced ProceduralModalProcessGraph
AP - atomic proposition type
public class WitnessTreeState<N,L,E,AP> extends Object
A utility class that represents a current configuration (node property) in the WitnessTree.
